caption: The video captures a large, dark tree stump burning in a wooded clearing during late autumn or winter. Bright orange-yellow flames engulf the stump's left and front faces, reshaping and flickering continuously throughout the view. Its right side remains blackened and largely unburned. A pile of weathered fallen logs and bare branches surrounds the base, with a small secondary flame flickering on one foreground log. That small flame sometimes grows into a short vertical tongue and sometimes shrinks to a point. Intermittent flame tongues and glowing embers rise above the stump's top edge, including a tall plume that flares and then subsides. The framing drifts slowly, shifting the stump and log pile toward the right while revealing more of the left background, where a fence and open field remain visible. The stump, logs, and trees stay fixed relative to the ground, so only the fire and embers move within the scene.
